# CLIMATE6 actual reading, 2026-10-24

Read all seven saved written prerequisite statement/proof bodies in prerequisites.json: CLIMATE3.4/3.6/4.4/4.7/5.9 and GEO1.9/4.6. SIG6.8, GEO6.2 and GEO8.8 are not assumed written; local integrating-factor and feedback arguments are supplied.

Rose: actual transient-toy teaching chapter, opening heat-capacity and diffusive-ocean sections, plus final transient/equilibrium summary and fast/slow discussion. This is a diffusive radiative-convective column, not a published coefficient calibration for our two-box model. The toy two-box equations and their eigenvalue proof come from the written prerequisite and an explicit local derivation. The old hypothetical two-layer-ebm.html route was 404. The actual lectures catalogue linked the distinct transient-toy chapter. Prior lecture18 stop remains binding.

NASA 2009 energy-budget article: radiative equilibrium, forcing, and ocean/surface heat redistribution passages. No claim to a current measured heat-imbalance value. NASA 2020 Ice Height article: paragraphs on ice altimetry and about 360 Gt freshwater per mm global sea level. No downloaded sea-level data series or scenarios.

NOAA PMEL What is El Nino: normal/El Nino trade winds, thermocline and upwelling passages. McPhaden/Zebiak/Glantz2006 original NOAA-hosted research HTML: ENSO Physics opening paragraphs on the Bjerknes feedback and 2-7-year irregular recurrence; do not attribute our local scalar equations to this paper or Bjerknes1969. Vialard et al2025: actual NOAA abstract only, two-variable SST/heat-content model and omitted nonlinear/stochastic extensions. Not the full review body.

Jones et al2019 ZECMIP: abstract and Introduction, including carbon/heat uptake cancellation and variable-sign/state-dependent ZEC. Actual complete 2-page corrigendum read: Python integer-division correction to bell-shaped B1-B3 emissions, approximately <0.1% cumulative difference. None of these tabulated experiments is reproduced by our prescribed reservoir. The attempted wrong GMD13/2985/2020 route returned404; no MacDougall2020 body was retrieved from a corrected/alternate source.

Max Planck Society2016 institutional research account of Notz/Stroeve: actual main article from heading through conclusion, approximately3m2 of September area per emitted tonne CO2. Not the original Science or supplement body. NSIDC Science of sea ice: actual albedo, seasonal melt, and satellite-measurement sections. No current-year ice series claimed; area and extent remain distinct.

New binding stops: IPCC AR6 chapters2/7/9 direct403; NOAA Climate.gov global-sea-level article403; Bjerknes1969 publisher body403. Older IPCC4 direct403 and lecture18 stops remain. No alternate-host, cached or PDF recovery of these bodies. Bjerknes original metadata is frozen and verify:true is explicit. Search results containing stopped IPCC snippets were not opened or treated as body reads.
